subject: MedBridge: post-demo IAM & security follow-up and evidence request
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Denton <cdenton@medbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: IAM & security next steps for MedBridge

Hi Claire — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the compliance items you asked about during the demo.

Recap (from call)
- Use case: clinical notes summarization and internal search for care teams (PHI scope: patient identifiers + notes).
- Requirements flagged: SOC 2 Type II evidence, HIPAA BA considerations, SSO/SAML with SCIM provisioning, RBAC for auditor/admin separation, audit logs for data access.

Requested evidence / asks
- SOC 2 report (latest Type II) and any current gap assessments.
- High-level HIPAA compliance posture / BA checklist (is a BA required for your deployment?).
- SAML metadata (IdP certificate, ACS URL) or confirmation you support SP-initiated SSO.
- SCIM provisioning support (bulk provisioning API or SCIM 2.0 endpoints) + sample attribute mapping.
- RBAC matrix expectations (we can share a template) — who needs admin vs. auditor roles?

Proposed next steps
1) If you can, send the SOC 2 PDF and any security questionnaire your procurement team prefers (we'll fill and return).
2) Share SSO metadata + SCIM docs. If it's easier, attach SAML metadata XML — we can ingest it and stage a test.
3) Internal owners: I will coordinate the technical trial and test SSO; Marissa will own the compliance artifact collection; Ben will validate provisioning once we have endpoints.
4) Proposed timeline: evidence collection this week, test SSO next week, short POC by end of month.

Attachments: call_recording_20280322.mp4 (internal recording, link below)

Let me know if that matches your expectations and if procurement has a standard security questionnaire we should complete.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Claire Denton <cdenton@medbridgehealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medbridgehealth.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 17:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: IAM & security next steps for MedBridge

Sergio — great summary, thanks. Short answers and attachments below.

1) SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) in Nov 2027; attaching the report (redacted).
2) HIPAA: We handle PHI internally; for vendors we generally require a BA or signed BA addendum — security@medbridgehealth.com can confirm.
3) SSO: attaching SAML metadata (medbridge_sso_metadata.xml). We support SP-initiated SSO and can provide a test tenant.
4) SCIM: We expose a SCIM 2.0 endpoint for user provisioning; see short SCIM overview in the questionnaire. Attribute mapping is included in the attachment.
5) RBAC: We maintain an RBAC matrix internally; happy to review the template you mentioned.

Attachments (attached): MedBridge_Security_Questionnaire_Q1_2028.pdf; medbridge_sso_metadata.xml

Next steps: I'll loop in security@medbridgehealth.com to confirm BA requirements and to kick off the questionnaire review. If you send over the RBAC template and a shared drive link, we'll start filling it in.

Best,
Claire Denton
Director of IT Security
MedBridge Health
cdenton@medbridgehealth.com

Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700

Thanks for the update — looping internally so we can move quickly. Action items I propose (owners assigned):

- Marissa (me): collect SOC 2 artifact, export summary of our HIPAA controls and provide BA template options. I will upload to the shared folder.
- Ben: validate SCIM endpoints and do a quick API smoke test once Claire provides test credentials. Also confirm any attribute gaps.
- Sergio: confirm expected RBAC roles/levels from MedBridge (admin, auditor, clinician, integration) and push product team for any custom claims we might need.
- All: draft a 1-page evidence summary for procurement to speed contracting.

I created a folder and link under our internal drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-MedBridge-IAM-evidence — please add any docs there.

Timeline: SOC2 + questionnaire intake by EOD Friday (2028-03-24), SCIM test early next week, SSO smoke test mid-next-week. If that timeline doesn't work for MedBridge, we can shift.

I'll attach an RBAC template for them to fill out: RBAC_matrix_template.xlsx

Marissa
